title: Blue Max Charters
specs: Fishing for salmon and trout on Lake Michigan
World record Atlantic salmon caught on the Blue Max
Valid Wisconsin Fishing License and salmon stamp required
Groups limited to six paying passengers per boat by US Coast Guard law
Groups larger than six will be arranged on multiple vessels
includes: Ice for fish while on the boat
gap: Exact duration of each charter option not always stated clearly
blurb: Guests fish for salmon and trout on a 38 foot motor yacht using motor trolling with up to 14 rods. The captain and customers set tackle to provide artificial lures at various depths while moving through the water. The boat accommodates up to six paying passengers per charter, with arrangements for larger groups.
extraNote: $100 deposit required on all charters, personal check accepted for deposit only · Balance to be paid before trip at the boat in cash only; no personal checks or charge cards at the boat · Cancellation or transfer allowed up to 14 days before reservation with deposit return; after that deposit is lost · Captain may cancel trip before departure for safety and refund deposit · After departure, trip may be cancelled for safety with partial refund based on time and expenses · No refund for fishing license fees · No refund for trips cancelled due to excessive alcohol or any drug use
